question: Does changing the native Core Image working color space from extendedLinearSRGB to sRGB remove the moving reference-parity mismatch?
focusedCommand: temporarily build the native worker with sRGB workingColorSpace, run transition-delivery.mjs against an empty output directory, then compare its moving PNGs with the retained reference-parity oracle

result.conclusion: sRGB working surfaces materially worsen the mismatch; restore extendedLinearSRGB and keep the strict reference-conditioned gate open
